text: Welcome to Dream Job, an AI-assisted job search platform.
Everything starts with your profile. A LinkedIn export and a CV are merged into one traceable profile, with every disagreement surfaced rather than hidden.
On the Opportunities screen, every advertised role and every speculative opening is collected, ranked, and explained.
Then the Apply browser shows the prepared applications: the email, the CV, the briefing, and the motivation document.
The email is written from the profile, and the generated CV is grounded in it. Nothing appears that cannot be traced back.
A consistency check catches invented employers, dates and titles, and a leak scan keeps private documents out of the attachment.
Nothing is ever sent automatically. The job seeker reads, edits and approves every message. Here we stop before sending.
That was one minute of Dream Job. Profile in, ranked opportunities out, and you in control of every single send.
